title: Window CF2 (M8, session 3): confirmation of the shipped native default. nf = build/agent2/nativefinal-bin (N-A: FINAL native exe on the old SDK DLLs, miss cache ON by build default), plain launch, DEFAULT ARM, vs mc = native4b-bin + LEGO_NATIVE_SHADER_MISS_CACHE=1 (W8a's mc as timed). Optional: n0 (W8a's reference, miss cache OFF). W8a route and frames, 6 round-robin rounds, round 1 discarded
notes: Default arm (BIN-PINS D7): nf. Reference: mc. GO (primary): 'GO CF2 matrix-windowCF2.json <sha256> only=nf,mc repeats=6'. The launcher adds -ColdShared: one unscored cold run on the bin of round 1's first arm, which is nf (nativefinal-bin, staged without cache/; its native fingerprint 1616ce65e973c583 rejects any old recipe/pack, so its first launch is cold anyway), and mc keeps native4b's own cache. Then 6 round-robin rounds with the start arm alternating: 1 + 12 = 13 runs. Alternative with W8a's reference: 'only=nf,mc,n0 repeats=6', 1 + 18 = 19 runs (same file and sha256).

Warm-up policy: as CF1, the read-out drops round 1 (tags *-r1) and scores rounds 2-6 (5 per arm); check gpu.csv for the plateau at round 2; verdict with and without round 1. nf's first scored launch follows its unscored cold run, so its cache is warm in every scored run.

Question: is the plain FINAL native bin the same as W8a's mc (equivalence: nf vs mc CI inside about +-3 %, a timing claim only if the CI excludes 0)? With n0: does nf reproduce W8a's mc vs n0 (median about -29 %, fps about +44 %, p99 about -34 %; READOUT-NIGHT (3))?

Bins (build/agent2/final/BIN-PINS.md FE4CD4FF; the launcher hashes them before the first run; no restaging, never copy cache or seeds): nativefinal-bin MANIFEST sha256 D7C7B7060519A495 (legodimensions.exe 5C21941DAF9DF36B; rexruntime.dll / rexgpu-xenos.dll = native4b's), native4b-bin MANIFEST sha256 B63769FE46CC0459.

Arms, all W8a's cvars (native_settings_frontend=false, native_fps_limit=0, framerate_limit=0) and LEGO_NATIVE_FRAME_METRICS=<run>\native-frames.csv (the native frame source; the runner expands <run>). nf: no other env (plain launch: the miss cache is ON by build default). mc: LEGO_NATIVE_SHADER_MISS_CACHE=1 (W8a's mc). n0: no other env (W8a's n0; the old exe's default is OFF).

Proof per run, before any number is read (BIN-PINS D7): run.json env_set + the bin's MANIFEST sha256; nf -> build/agent2/final/check-defaults.py <game.log> --mode native-old (no 'Final defaults' / 1 ms / C1 / precise-wait / back-off lines, 'Native GPU: shader miss cache ON (build default)' exactly once) and env_set without LEGO_NATIVE_SHADER_MISS_CACHE; mc -> env_set has LEGO_NATIVE_SHADER_MISS_CACHE=1 (the old exe logs no miss-cache line); n0 -> env_set without it. No trace in any arm (a trace turns off reuse paths). Normal per-run functional check (exit 0, no dump/WER, level reached, K0/F0); a FAIL of an nf run voids the arm. STUCK-LOCK by the finding-10 rule, counted per arm.

Read-out: per pair the difference of medians with a bootstrap 95 % CI over the scored rounds, median ms, fps mean, p99, the 1 % low, process cores and render-thread ms/f (threads.csv). A timing claim needs a CI that excludes 0. Flag runs with non-game load >= median + 1 core (M12 gate) and give verdicts with and without them. sys.csv rows are all 31-column (runner 72370A1E); never pool with 24-column rows.

Window: 5 s settle + 55 s warm-up from the first frame, then 50 s measured (every window >= 60 s after the first frame; window_before_floor below 59.5 s); the cold run 55 s warm-up, 30 s window. One frame source for every arm: native-frames.csv (frames native), uncapped; one driver (drivers/thread-cpu.ps1). sys_csv on.

Scope: W8a's route, uncapped, AC power, this laptop. Native numbers compare only with native runs in this window. Timing comes only from the user's unlocked, idle desktop through a launcher; agent runs of this matrix (-Quick, hidden desktop) are functional only.

arms.note: DEFAULT ARM: nativefinal plain launch (miss cache ON by build default). Proof: check-defaults --mode native-old, env_set without LEGO_NATIVE_SHADER_MISS_CACHE (MANIFEST D7C7B7060519A495)
W8a's mc as timed: native4b + LEGO_NATIVE_SHADER_MISS_CACHE=1, no trace. Proof: env_set only (MANIFEST B63769FE46CC0459)
optional: W8a's n0, native4b with the miss cache OFF (old default). Proof: env_set without LEGO_NATIVE_SHADER_MISS_CACHE
